Name: Zenith Farm - Chinese (Mandarin)
Author: MaxMixST
Description:
[size=3][b][u]2025.7.16 最新消息：此汉化补丁已被 Zenith Farm 地图作者 DaisyNiko 收录到 1.5 版本中，大家无需再下载此补丁~
多谢各位的支持，请移步下载最新版地图 MOD ！[/u][/b][/size]

----------------------------------------------------------------


[size=2]这是由[/size][i][b] [/b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko?gameId=1303]DaisyNiko[/url] [/i][size=2]制作的 [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15618][i]Zenith Farm[/i] [/url][size=2]农场地图模组的[/size][b]简体中文（普通话）汉化补丁[/b][size=2]。[/size]


[b]- 本补丁包含以下内容：[/b]

[list]
[*][size=2]农场地图内的传送点、地标名称的翻译（PS[i]：[b]农场地图中的矿车站点名称[/b] 需通过 [b]“[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]通用配置菜单（Generic Mod Config Menu）[/b][/url]﻿”[/b] 自行自定义，否则默认显示为英文[/i]）[/size]
[size=2]
[/size][*][size=2]初始剧情对话（罗宾、刘易斯镇长的迎新剧情）完整翻译[/size]
[size=2]
[/size][*][size=2]模组配置菜单的选项名称翻译[/size]
[/list][size=2]

[b]- 安装方法：[/b]

[list]
[*]请先下载并安装原始模组 Zenith Farm 及其所需的前置模组/依赖文件；
[/list][list]
[*]下载本汉化补丁；
[/list][list]
[*]解压补丁后，将其中的文件覆盖原模组目录中的文件；
[/list][list]
[*]使用 SMAPI 启动游戏即可。
[/list][/size]
[size=2]----------------------------------------------------------------[/size]

[size=2]This is a [b]Simplified Chinese (Mandarin) translation patch[/b] for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15618][i][b]Zenith Farm[/b][/i][/url] maps mod by[i][b] [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko?gameId=1303][b]DaisyNiko[/b][/url].[/b][/i]

This translation is for players who use Chinese (Simplified Mandarin) and want a more immersive experience. All credit goes to the original author — this patch only provides the language localization.

[b]- This patch includes:[/b]

[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Translation of map labels and warp point names (Note: Minecart station names must be customized manually in the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098] [i][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/i][/url][i][b]﻿,[/b][/i] otherwise they will remain in English.)[/size]
[*][size=2]Full localization of event dialogues (e.g. Robin and Mayor Lewis’s introduction)[/size]
[*][size=2]Translated config options in the mod menu[/size]
[/list][size=2][b]
- Installation Instructions：[/b]

[/size][list]
[*][size=2]First, download and install the original Zenith Farm mod along with its required dependencies.[/size]
[*][size=2]Download this Chinese translation patch.[/size]
[*][size=2]Extract this patch, and overwrite the original mod files in your Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
